title: Align GitHub CI with advisory Clippy and blocking compilation
outcome: Align GitHub CI with advisory Clippy and blocking compilation
acceptance: The CI quality job uses an uncapped all-target/all-feature compile check and the agreed capped Clippy command, so Clippy warnings alone do not turn CI red while compiler failures still fail the job.
Retain the existing formatting and test failure behavior; verify the command behavior through meaningful existing fixtures or the smallest applicable probe, without adding a Markdown-content test.
